description: This Java source file defines the HttpEngine class, which extends GenericAsyncEngine, providing methods for executing services synchronously and handling HTTP requests for service invocation within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes serialization/deserialization of context, HTTP communication, and response handling.

classes.name: HttpEngine
classes.description: A class extending GenericAsyncEngine that handles service execution and HTTP request processing for services in the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Executes a service synchronously by serializing the context, making an HTTP request, and deserializing the response.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Calls runSync and ignores its result.

methods.name: httpEngine
methods.description: Handles incoming HTTP requests to invoke services, deserialize context, execute the service, serialize the result, and write the response.
